newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Golf-Harrington leads the field at Smurfit Open.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Harrington leads the field at Smurfit Open.

text.p: Irish golfer Paidrig Harrington, was leading the field in the Smurfit European Open in Kildare on Thursday after finishing the day on a seven-under-par 65.
Harrington, 25, from Rathfarnham in Dublin won the Spanish Open in May and currently lies 11th on the order of merit with more than 233,000 Irish pounds in prizemoney.
Harrington had two birdies in the first three holes and an scored an eagle three on the 518-yard 18th. The Smurfit European Open has a first prize of 125,000 Irish pounds.
